prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Sign your name and confirm your companion's core personality traits.", "Sign Owner Name"]
1: ["Learn Controls", "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click to open actions or hide to system tray.", "Right-click to talk, feed, or minimize your pet to system tray anytime.", "Start Playing with Pet"]
2: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Companion", "Pick a quick ready-made companion pet or create a custom pet from your photos.", "Select Path"]
3: ["Verify Photos", "Photo Quality Check", "We analyzed your photo to ensure smooth 3D pet rendering.", "Photo Quality: Excellent", "Looks Great, Create Pet!"]
4: ["Verifying Desktop Display Support", "Ensuring your pet will overlay smoothly above your open desktop windows.", "Desktop Overlay Ready", "Launch Pet"]
5: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account to automatically restore all your existing pets and progress."]
6: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet...", "Compiling 3D animations and desktop physics. This usually takes under 3 minutes."]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready! Claim Free Accessory", "Welcome your pet to the desktop to unlock an exclusive starter hat accessory.", "Unlocked: Founder Starter Accessory"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Don't worry about choosing perfectly — you can adopt more pets or customize your pet anytime later!"]
9: ["Choose Your Ready-Made Companion", "Select any pet below to immediately begin adoption."]
